title: Bind the existing Persona OODA owner for case-file reads
register_work_package: RC2 WP2.3 (corrective follow-up to BFF-DECISION-CASE-FILE-VIEWS-20261113 and Persona-cycle hosted acceptance)

incident_context.symptom: Authenticated tenant-dev GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{id} returned 200 with 4 paper cycle packets for each of the 3 naturally enrolled trading personas, while GET /bff/ooda/packets/{id} returned 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for all 6 sampled packet IDs (including the 3 natural judge witnesses from run 44799897172 artifact 14659936770) even though the mounted owner file held all 6 under tenant-dev and paper with 1 recorded case file each.
incident_context.root_cause: AppDependencies.create_default and create_read_surface_ports constructed OodaManagementDomainPort without binding the Persona OODA owner store decoder on OodaPacketsPort, and ReadSurfacePorts.dataset_source('ooda_packets') returned a static 'typed_store' fallback instead of the OodaPacketsPort surface status. Meanwhile personas/cycle_views.py and ports/persona_pool.py each opened resolve_ooda_packet_store_path() + read_packets(path) locally when OodaPacketsPort reported source='missing'.

owned_layer: BFF OODA packet domain port, read-surface composition, bootstrap wiring, and consolidated Persona cycle/pool owner reads
not_changed: Persona OODA packet store writer (append_ooda_packet / compact_ooda_packet_store), data format, or retention policy
Case-file composition and projection (bff/agora/committee/owner.py project_packet / project_case_file)
Authenticated tenant admission and paper/live boundaries
Public HTTP route paths and response contracts
changes: services/control-plane/bff/ports/ooda_management.py: bind the existing read-only Persona OODA owner decoder (resolve_ooda_packet_store_path + read_packets) in OodaPacketsPort / create_ooda_packets_port when PANTHEON_BFF_OODA_PACKET_STORE, PANTHEON_OODA_DATA_DIR, or PANTHEON_CONTROL_PLANE_DATA_DIR is configured and no explicit store or records_provider is injected; enforce paper environment alongside authenticated tenant scope on persona_cycle packets

services/control-plane/bff/ports/read_surface_ports.py: wire create_ooda_packets_port() into create_read_surface_ports and create_in_memory_read_surface_ports, and resolve ReadSurfacePorts.dataset_source('ooda_packets') from ooda_management.ooda.get_surface_status()
services/control-plane/bff/bootstrap/dependencies.py: bind and validate OodaPacketsPort (create_ooda_packets_port) in AppDependencies.create_default and pass it into create_read_surface_ports

services/control-plane/bff/personas/cycle_views.py and services/control-plane/bff/ports/persona_pool.py: remove redundant local resolve_ooda_packet_store_path/read_packets fallback blocks so Persona cycle summaries, strategy pool cycle views, and OODA list/detail routes all read through read_store.ooda_management.ooda

services/control-plane/bff/test_mgmt_ooda_004_bff_routes.py, tests/test_case_file_views.py, tests/test_ooda_management_ports.py, tests/test_persona_cycle_views.py: consolidate redundant test-local packet normalizers and dataset_source overrides and verify normal composition end-to-end
services/control-plane/bff/BFF_API_CONTRACT.md: document the shared OodaPacketsPort owner decoder binding across Persona summaries and OODA packet list/detail routes

covered_scenarios: Normal BFF composition (AppDependencies.create_default -> create_read_surface_ports -> ReadSurfacePorts) resolves the same stored paper packets across GET /bff/personas/{id}, GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{id}, GET /bff/ooda/packets, and GET /bff/ooda/packets/{packet_id} with data.case_file_view populated and raw persona_cycle.case_files stripped
Cross-tenant isolation and spoofed X-Tenant-Id rejection (404 on Persona summary and OODA detail, empty OODA list, zero private case-file leakage)
Paper/live boundary enforcement (non-paper persona_cycle packets excluded from Persona summary, OODA list, and OODA detail)

Absent or unreadable owner store (meta.surfaces.persona_cycles, meta.surfaces.autonomy_cycles, meta.surfaces.ooda_packets, and meta.surfaces.ooda_packet_detail report status='unavailable' with degraded detail envelope)
Genuine missing packet ID when owner store is present returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
Injected OodaPacketsPort (OodaLoopStore, OodaJsonlAppendStore, records_provider, or explicit ooda_port) precedence over environment store path

Private-memory projection (own persona sees persona_private items; other persona has persona_private items withheld with private_items_withheld count) and byte-identical read-only owner store file before/after reads

hosted_acceptance_check_for_coordinator.note: Hosted acceptance remains with the existing coordinator tasks above after a Dev Root deploys this merge.
read_only_same_tenant_summary_to_detail_: 1. Confirm served pair identity via GET /deployment.json on the dev FE origin and GET /bff/version on the dev BFF origin, and verify authenticated tenant-dev scope via GET /bff/me (HTTP 200, tenant_id='tenant-dev').

2. For each of the three trading personas (persona-2448c7053e33ea48da47, persona-ee7112a829d38b9135ac, persona-6507750312870d03a241), issue an authenticated read-only GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{persona_id} (or GET /bff/personas/{persona_id}) with the same tenant-dev Bearer token. Confirm HTTP 200, meta.surfaces.persona_cycles.status == 'ok', and collect the displayed packet_id values from data.personaCycle.cycle.packets (including the six packet IDs above while retained in the 30-day/1000-record window).

3. Issue an authenticated read-only GET /bff/ooda/packets with the same tenant-dev token and confirm HTTP 200, meta.surfaces.ooda_packets.status == 'ok', meta.surfaces.ooda_packets.source == 'store', and that the listed packet_id set includes the displayed paper persona-cycle packets.

4. For each of the six packet IDs from step 2, issue an authenticated read-only GET /bff/ooda/packets/{packet_id} with the same tenant-dev token. Confirm HTTP 200 (no 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND), data.packet_id == packet_id, meta.surfaces.ooda_packet_detail.status == 'ok', 'case_files' not in data.persona_cycle, and data.case_file_view.status == 'ok' with non-empty data.case_file_view.case_files[0].groups (each item carrying item_id, excerpt, source_owner, source_id, retrieval_mode) and data.case_file_view.decisions.

5. In an authenticated Chromium session on the served FE/BFF pair, open /management/personas/{persona_id} for one of the three trading personas, expand a cycle packet row using its case-file toggle so the browser issues GET /bff/ooda/packets/{packet_id} (HTTP 200), and confirm the rendered CaseFileViewPanel displays the case-file groups, excerpts, source IDs, retrieval modes, and decision citations.
